topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and objectives for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and receptor signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular processes involved in mounting an inflammatory response, from sentinel cell signaling and leukocyte extravasation to systemic effects like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms required to terminate inflammation, restore damaged tissue, and manage persistent infections through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and announces the subject of the subsequent lecture.
